title: Molten Canadian Duck Casserole
description: A rich and savory casserole featuring tender duck, smothered in a molten Canadian cheese sauce. Gluten-free.
instructions: Cook gluten-free pasta according to package instructions.
Season duck breast with salt and pepper.
Sear duck breast in a skillet until browned, then set aside.
In the same skillet, cook Canadian bacon until crispy.
In a separate saucepan, melt molten cheese blend over low heat.
Combine cooked pasta, duck breast, and Canadian bacon in a 9x13 inch casserole dish.
Pour molten cheese sauce over the top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cheese is bubbly and duck is cooked through.
